messages:
ops-bot: Pager: [SEV=prod-high] GPU pool redwood-pool-7 queue length >120 for 5m, p99 lat > 3.2s. Alert ID PGR-20250315-7. Auto-scale attempted but hit policy limit.

oncall_tom: saw this spike ~1m ago. I'm on it.

maya_se: the rollout for model v2.9.1 went to stable 10m ago — any correlation?

jim_infra: early signs point to context expansion. v2.9.1 changed default context strategy -> eager kv prefetch; more KV entries per request.

sara_support: customer banner: several external customers reporting timeouts on generation endpoint, ~8% errors from last 15m. Notified SLA team.

oncall_tom: digging into metrics: queue_length by pool: redwood-pool-7 = 132, redwood-pool-3 = 9. p50/p95/p99 latency = 220ms / 1.1s / 3.3s. tokens/sec per GPU dropped from 18k to 9k.

alex_platform: autoscaler logs show spawn requests failing with 403 quota.limit_exceeded for region-us-west2. Burst capacity disabled due to committed pool cap.

maya_se: can we fallback traffic to lower-cost model variant (v2.9.0-quant) while infra recovers? That preserves correctness for most customers.

jim_infra: agree. Start routing 30% to fallback, then 60% if stable. Also start manual eviction of long-running sessions on pool-7.

oncall_tom: initiating rolling traffic split via routing rule change now. Command: ```rbctl routes set --route gen --variant v2.9.0-quant --percent 30 --pool redwood-pool-7```

ops-bot: deploy-bot: Routing change applied (request id r-7b3c).

sara_support: raising high-priority customer comms draft. Will post to status page once we have fallback completion.

jim_infra: manual probe: found many requests with context length 1.2M tokens (bad) — looks like a tokenization bug in the new model launcher that duplicated context shards on warm-up.

maya_se: that would explain KV entries explosion. We need a rollback of the launcher config ASAP.

oncall_tom: autoscaler still failing to create instances: error stream snippet: ```ERROR: pool-launcher: insufficient quota: GPUs exceeded quota 64/64```

alex_platform: approved emergency quota request submitted to cloud team, but ETA 25-40m. Not safe to rely on.

jim_infra: mitigation plan: 1) continue traffic split to fallback; 2) throttle long-context requests at ingress (limit context tokens to 256k for now); 3) evict and drain redwood-pool-7; 4) patch launcher to stop duplicating context.

oncall_tom: I've put a temporary ingress throttle: ```nginx rule: if ctx_len > 256000 return 429``` —Applying to gen/v2 variants only.

sara_support: posted interim status: "Degraded performance for generation API in US-West. Temporary throttling and fallback routing in effect. Working on autoscale and rollback." customers asked for ETA.

maya_se: who's owner for the launcher patch? @jim_infra?

jim_infra: yes, grabbing it. Reproduced locally. Patch ready: switch prefetch flag from eager->lazy and add guard dedupe. Will push after smoke test.

ops-bot: incident-bot: oncall handoff in 2h. Current incident severity: prod-high.

alex_platform: after routing change, queue dropped to 48 in 7 minutes, p99 down to 1.4s. throughput recovering.

oncall_tom: good. Keep throttling rule active and hold rollout. I'll start a canary rollback for model launcher to previous stable config.

jim_infra: rolling launcher config rollback now: ```kubectl apply -f launcher-config-stable.yaml --context prod --namespace runtime```

ops-bot: deploy-bot: launcher-config rollback triggered (deploy id d-21a9).

maya_se: monitoring KV cache hit rate — currently low because entries exploded and then got evicted; after rollback we should see warmup drop and hit-rate normalize.

sara_support: customers asking for credit. I advised we'll follow up once postmortem has impact assessment.

oncall_tom: action items: (1) jim_infra finish rollback and smoke test, (2) alex_platform monitor autoscaler quota and open emergency limit request, (3) maya_se verify model variants and patch release gating, (4) sara_support draft customer-impact summary + credits policy.

jim_infra: rollback completed and smoke tests pass. Observed kv-cache entries reduced by 78%, memory usage on GPUs dropped ~42%.

alex_platform: autoscaler queued create attempts retried; with lower mem usage, new instances accepted. Queue length now 12.

oncall_tom: lowering severity to prod-medium. Leaving oncall watch for next 2 hours. Handing off to second-line @alex_platform for follow-up.

ops-bot: incidents-bot: handoff recorded. New owner: alex_platform. Next update expected in 30m. :white_check_mark:
